name: Yunjin brocade
where: Shop at the Nanjing Yunjin Museum
about: Yunjin is a traditional silk brocade woven in Nanjing for centuries. Small items are often made from leftover fabric scraps.
tip: Buy a small item made from fabric scraps. It is an easy and affordable way to take home real Nanjing silk.

name: Yuhua tea
where: Official sales point of Nongcui (Tea Research Institute, Nanjing Agricultural University)
about: Yuhua tea is a green tea grown in the hills around Nanjing. It is known for its fresh, delicate flavor.
tip: Check the prices by grade before you buy. A 60 g box is a good size to try first.
